sources.title: Steam97Web official help, About Gas Tables / Calculate Properties of Gases
sources.evidence: BSW2003; dissociation up to 2000 K, complete combustion, lambda strictly greater than 1.05; eight percentage fields and Include Dissociation checkbox.
sources.does_not_establish: Lambda inference, correction equations, output units, derivative semantics, pressure range or minimum dissociation temperature.

sources.title: R. Span (2004), Thermophysical Properties of Aqueous Systems for Analysis and Design of Power Cycles with CO2 Capture
sources.locations: Relevant Temperatures and Pressures, printed p.6; bibliography [17], printed p.8.
sources.evidence: Author explicitly excludes oxyfuel processes from the simplified Buecker et al. dissociation model. Reference [17] identifies the 2003 paper, volume 125, pp.374-383.
sources.does_not_establish: A numerical nitrogen cutoff, oxygen-enrichment threshold, implementation equations or site rejection behaviour.

sources.title: FluidVIEW LibIdGasMix documentation, Zittau/Goerlitz University
sources.locations: PDF pp.12-14, reference states and range of validity.
sources.evidence: This library documents VDI 4670 dissociation and its own pressure, composition and reference-state policies.
sources.use: Model disambiguation. PTB-CP-3 establishes a BSW/VDI connection, but equality of editions and implementations is not proven; library policies cannot be assigned to Steam97Web.

sources.title: Buecker, Span, Wagner (2003), Thermodynamic Property Models for Moist Air and Combustion Gases
sources.use: Required primary correction source; bibliography identifies the target, but abstract is insufficient for implementation.

sources.title: Modelica Standard Library ReferenceMoistAir, ReactionIndices and cp/h/s dissociation functions
sources.evidence: All six A-E coefficient rows, U2-U6, V2-V6 and caloric correction functions; cites VDI 4670 (2003).
sources.limitations: Humid-air subset without U1 for CO/CO2; source derivative inconsistencies and D2 sign conflict documented in modelica-source-audit.json. Not run in a Modelica compiler or validated against Steam97Web.

sources.title: Herrmann et al. (2009), PTB-CP-3, Determination of Thermodynamic and Transport Properties of Humid Air for Power-Cycle Calculations
sources.locations: Printed pp.28-29,108 and bibliography [16]/[23], PDF pp.29-30,109,123.
sources.evidence: Primary report links simplified VDI 4670 dissociation to Buecker/Span/Wagner 2003; identifies T>1200 K and oxygen mole fraction at least 1%.
sources.limitation: Caloric correction terms named rather than all equations/coefficients provided. These are report model conditions, not confirmed site policy.
